title: Normalize optional retry budgets
description: A configuration helper filters an optional retry count before applying the default.
commitMessage: Treat nonpositive retry values as unspecified configuration.
reviewContext: None means use three retries. Some(0) explicitly disables retries, so the initial attempt is the only attempt. Other configured values are prevalidated in 1..=10. maximum_attempts includes the initial attempt. No network operations are performed in these helpers.
